widget.draw: function draw(ctx, state, t) { var w = state.w; var h = state.h; var r = state.r; var d = state.d; function fmt(v) { return Math.round(v * 100) / 100; } var lora_params = r * 2 * d; var full_params = d * d; var maxFull = 1024 * 1024; var maxW = 440; var wf = full_params / maxFull * maxW; var wl = lora_params / maxFull * maxW; if (wl < 2) { wl = 2; } ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.fillStyle = "#f6f3ec"; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.fillStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.font = "15px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("LoRA vs full fine-tuning", 24, 28); ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.fillStyle = "#5c564c"; ctx.fillText("bars to same scale", 24, 46); ctx.fillStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.font = "13px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("LoRA A plus B", 24, 110); ctx.fillText("full d by d", 24, 190); ctx.fillStyle = "#e4d6c4"; ctx.fillRect(180, 88, maxW, 30); ctx.fillRect(180, 168, maxW, 30); ctx.fillStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.fillRect(180, 88, wl, 30); ctx.fillStyle = "#c4512c"; ctx.fillRect(180, 168, wf, 30); ctx.fillStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.font = "13px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("lora_params = " + fmt(lora_params), 180, 138); ctx.fillText("full_params = " + fmt(full_params), 180, 218); ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.fillStyle = "#5c564c"; ctx.fillText("r = " + fmt(r), 24, 260); ctx.fillText("d = " + fmt(d), 24, 280); ctx.fillText("r x 2 x d vs d x d", 180, 260); var y2 = 280; var x2 = 180; var n = Math.round(r); var i = 0; for (i = 0; i < n; i++) { ctx.fillStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.fillRect(x2 + i * 22, y2, 16, 16); } ctx.strokeStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.strokeRect(180, 88, maxW, 30); ctx.strokeRect(180, 168, maxW, 30); }
